title: Cryptographic Shredding & NeroNuke Governance
description: Fail-closed cryptographic data obliteration, 4-Eyes dual authorization workflows, legal hold preservation compliance, and Dead Man's Switch controls.

dualAuth.bannerText: Destruction operations require two distinct administrators. The initiator cannot approve their own request, and active legal holds unconditionally abort any shredding action.
dualAuth.searchPlaceholder: Filter destruction requests by target, initiator, status...

requestModal.title: Request Cryptographic Destruction
requestModal.description: Propose an irreversible crypto-shredding operation. A second administrator must approve before execution.
requestModal.confirmation: Type CONFIRM DESTRUCTION to confirm the request

approveModal.title: Approve & Execute Irreversible Destruction
approveModal.warning: CRITICAL WARNING: This action permanently overwrites organization data encryption keys with random cryptographic noise. Decryption of all tenant data and audit records will become physically impossible.
approveModal.holdBlocked: DESTRUCTION BLOCKED: An active legal hold is currently imposed on this target.
approveModal.confirmationPrompt: I certify that I am a distinct administrator and authorize permanent cryptographic obliteration.

dualAuth.rejectDesc: The request is closed and nothing is erased.

legalHolds.bannerText: Imposing a legal hold unconditionally blocks all cryptographic shredding and dead man's switch executions across the specified organization. Holds can only be released by authorized compliance officers.
legalHolds.searchPlaceholder: Filter legal holds by organization, reason, hold ID...

imposeModal.title: Impose Compliance Legal Hold
imposeModal.description: Enforce a preservation order on an organization to prevent any key shredding or automated data purge.
imposeModal.reasonHint: Case number, regulatory subpoena, or court order

releaseModal.title: Remove the legal hold?
releaseModal.description: Once the hold is removed, erasures for this organisation become possible again. Continue?

dms.title: Network Owner Dead Man's Switch
dms.description: Automated failsafe wipe triggered if the network owner heartbeat fails to refresh within the configured grace period.
dms.heartbeatDesc: Re-enter owner master passphrase to reset the server-side global wipe clock.
dms.emergencyDesc: Immediately shreds all tenant data, databases, and caches across the entire global mesh.

emergencyModal.title: CONFIRM GLOBAL DESTRUCTION
emergencyModal.warning: THIS WILL DESTROY THE ENTIRE NERONET MESH AND ALL TENANT DATA PERMANENTLY.

purge.phraseMismatch: Type exactly DESTROY EVERYTHING PERMANENTLY to confirm.
